notes.title: January 2024 Dev Update
notes.notes:
🌟 This month's highlight reel showcases our stunning Fluid Flux water system. Immerse yourself in the tranquility of our world as the player character contemplates the sea's eternal ballet against the shore.

[previewyoutube=wjhoPZ98NZg;full][/previewyoutube]

But that's just the crest of the wave! Here's what we've been forging in the fires of development:

🤖 AI Architecture: Embarked on the journey to create NPCs with brains to match their brawn, capable of learning and evolving.

🏛️ Government Systems: Mapped the blueprint of power and politics that will govern the lands and its people.

🛡️ Faction Structures: Outlined the intricate tapestry of alliances and conflicts that will fuel the game's narrative.

By the numbers, our kingdom now boasts:

10,822 Static Mesh assets to build a world rich in detail.
2,847 Skeletal Mesh Assets, ensuring every character moves with purpose.
512 Unique player animations for unparalleled immersion.
✅ Achievements Unlocked:

Fluid Flux Water system: Bringing the sea to life with each ebb and flow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787521/bd881c02d368c71b948d7343228474fe40e032b5.png
Ultra Dynamic Sky: A day and night cycle complete with dynamic weather to keep adventurers on their toes.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787521/90ca4ca6df3f9c573d0e979ed833009eefab183f.png
Crossbow Mechanics: Delivering a bolt of excitement with every twang and thud.
We're excited to share these milestones with our community as we craft a gaming experience like no other.

Stay tuned, and thank you for being part of this journey!
